main.bio: I am an AI and Data Science professional with approximately 6 years of experience contributing to enterprise machine-learning, predictive analytics, and Generative AI solutions across Automotive, Manufacturing, and FinTech. I work with Python, model evaluation, Azure OpenAI, GPT-4o, RAG, semantic and vector search, and AI-powered document workflows. My work has contributed to solutions associated with approximately 40% lower troubleshooting time and 55% less manual document-processing effort. I currently work as a Technology Lead (AI) at Infosys, contributing to SDLC.AI's Agent Control Framework for autonomous application creation across Greenfield and Brownfield development.

resume.skillmessage: A practical toolkit spanning predictive machine learning, generative AI, application engineering, and stakeholder-focused delivery.

education.degree: Professional Certificate Programme - Advanced Business Management

work.title: Technology Lead (AI) - Service Transformation
work.description: Contribute to enterprise AI/ML and GenAI initiatives, translating business needs into solution requirements with engineering and business stakeholders. Contribute to SDLC.AI's Agent Control Framework for autonomous creation of production-grade Greenfield and Brownfield applications, including Tokenomics and a Telemetry Dashboard. Support solution evaluation across Automotive, Manufacturing, and FinTech; earned three promotions in approximately 3.7 years at Infosys. Selected project contributions include predictive fault detection using XGBoost and business-defined precision/recall thresholds; an LLM and vector-search diagnostic assistant associated with approximately 40% lower troubleshooting time; AI document extraction and multistate validation associated with approximately 55% less manual processing; an AI e-delivery onboarding assistant; and Angular modernization for a FinTech client.

work.title: Associate Software Engineer
work.description: Built an AI-powered NLP resume parser to reduce manual candidate-data entry and support recruitment workflows. Led a five-member team delivering analytics-enabled management systems, APIs, and web applications. Contributed to semantic search, automated ticket and email categorization, and an image-captioning system using CNN-LSTM techniques.
